_: Holtburg raids (RevivalGuard TownRaid.cs, TownRaidRule.cs; docs/findings/holtburg-raids-2026-11-15.md). Retail monsters only, unchanged (owner 2026-11-15: existing weenies, no new or modified ones). The copy beside the mod dll is the live one: edit it there and it is read again within a minute, no restart; a newer copy built into the mod replaces it only if it was not hand-edited (SeedFileRule). Points are [x, y] in A9B4 metres (Holtburg's block; the lifestone is at 81, 12); the server puts them on the ground. Every leg was checked on the outdoor layer (findings doc). Turbine voice: plain ASCII, no em dashes, nothing modern. Tokens: {group} {side} {leader} {count} {n} {item} {name}.
